# Clean Yield

> Clean Yield publishes data tools (Actors) on the Apify platform that return structured, ready-to-use rows from public web sources and official open data. Every Actor is pay per result (no subscription, no platform usage fee on top), does not charge failed or incomplete results, respects a maximum cost per run, and has a Lite version with no per-result charge limited to 25 results per run.

Run any Actor from the Apify Store, the Apify API (`POST https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/cleanyield~<actor-name>/run-sync-get-dataset-items` with an Apify token and the input as JSON; add `maxTotalChargeUsd` to cap the cost), n8n, Make, or AI agents through the Apify MCP server. Prices below are for the Apify Free plan; paid Apify plans get lower tiers.

## Actors

- [Company Enrichment from Website](https://apify.com/cleanyield/company-enrichment-from-website): Turns a list of company websites or domains, or a Google Maps export pasted as it is, into one row per company with contact emails, phone numbers and address when the site publishes them, LinkedIn and social profiles, the tech stack the site runs on and hiring signals. It reads only public pages of each company’s own site and respects robots.txt. Returns one row per company: companyName, description, country, language; emails; phones, primaryPhone; address; socialProfiles; technologies; hiring. Input: domains (or full website URLs), or rows / csvUrl / datasetId with a Google Maps export; optional sections, maxPagesPerDomain, includePersonalEmails. Try the Lite version first (no per-result charge, up to 25 results per run): https://apify.com/cleanyield/company-enrichment-from-website-lite · Price today: USD 10 per 1,000 companies (USD 0.01 per company returned) on the Apify Free plan; Apify subscribers pay less (Gold: USD 7 per 1,000). From November 24, 2026: The Gold tier moves to USD 7.50 per 1,000, and monitor mode adds USD 0.005 per watched company per monitor run (today monitor mode charges only new or changed companies).
- [ATS Jobs Scraper](https://apify.com/cleanyield/ats-jobs-scraper): Returns the live open jobs of any company straight from its own careers page on 19 hiring systems (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday, Oracle Recruiting Cloud, Eightfold, Phenom, SuccessFactors, iCIMS, Recruitee, Personio, Teamtailor and more), in one format, with no expired listings. Coverage, two numbers measured on 2026-11-11: on a fixed sample of 286 well-known companies (mostly mid-size and large: Fortune 500, scale-ups, healthcare, industry and retail in the US, Europe and Latin America) it reads the jobs of 72.7% (208) from their website alone; on a broader random sample of 1,000 companies (many small, plus Europe and Latin America) it reads 40.1% of those with a visible careers page (27.2% of all reachable ones), about 55% of US mid-size and large companies but under 10% of small ones. Returns one row per job: title, department, company; location, city, countryCode, workplaceType; employmentType; salaryAnnualMin, salaryAnnualMax, salaryCurrency, salaryText; postedAt, url, applyUrl; descriptionText / descriptionHtml. Input: companies (names, board tokens or careers page URLs); optional keywords, locations, workplaceTypes, postedWithinDays, maxJobsPerCompany. Try the Lite version first (no per-result charge, up to 25 results per run): https://apify.com/cleanyield/ats-jobs-scraper-lite · Price today: USD 2 per 1,000 jobs (USD 0.002 per job) plus USD 0.005 per run, on the Apify Free plan; Silver and Gold subscribers pay USD 1.20 per 1,000. From November 24, 2026: USD 5 per 1,000 jobs (USD 0.005 per job) plus USD 0.005 per run; Silver and Gold USD 3 per 1,000.
- [FMCSA Carrier Lookup](https://apify.com/cleanyield/fmcsa-carrier-data): Looks up US trucking companies by USDOT or MC number, or lists carriers by state, city, ZIP code or radius, including the ones that registered in the last days, from official FMCSA data; statuses that may be out of date in the open data are re-checked live on SAFER. Returns one row per carrier: dotNumber, mcNumbers, legalName, companyName; usdotStatus, authorityStatus, authority; insurancePolicies, insuranceSummary; safety, safetyRating, outOfService; powerUnits, drivers, cargoCarried, physicalAddress; phone, email; leadScore, leadTier. Input: dotNumbers or mcNumbers; or states, cities, zipCodes, nearLocation + radiusMiles, addedWithinDays, entityTypes. Try the Lite version first (no per-result charge, up to 25 results per run): https://apify.com/cleanyield/fmcsa-carrier-data-lite · Price today: USD 5 per 1,000 carriers (USD 0.005 per carrier) on the Apify Free plan; Apify subscribers pay less (Gold: USD 3.50 per 1,000). From November 24, 2026: Monitor mode adds USD 0.001 per watched carrier per monitor run (today monitor mode charges only new or changed carriers). The price per carrier does not change.
- [App Store & Google Play Reviews Scraper](https://apify.com/cleanyield/app-store-google-play-reviews): Returns the reviews of any iPhone (App Store) or Android (Google Play) app in one format, for any country and language, with filters by rating, date and keyword. Returns one row per review: store, appName, appId; rating, title, text; date, appVersion; country, language; developerReply; url, thumbsUp. Input: apps (App Store or Google Play links or IDs); optional countries, languages, maxReviewsPerApp, minRating, maxRating, reviewsSince, keywords. Try the Lite version first (no per-result charge, up to 25 results per run): https://apify.com/cleanyield/app-store-google-play-reviews-lite · Price today: USD 0.10 per 1,000 reviews (10,000 reviews = USD 1) on the Apify Free plan; subscribers pay slightly less. From November 24, 2026: Monitor mode checks cost USD 0.01 per app per monitor run (USD 0.005 today). The price per review does not change.
- [Latin America Public Tenders](https://apify.com/cleanyield/latam-public-tenders): Returns public tenders from Colombia (SECOP), Brazil (PNCP), Chile (Mercado Público) and Paraguay (DNCP) in one format, with an English title, the amount in USD when the tender states one, the buyer and the bid deadline. Returns one row per tender: tenderId, country, source, url; title, titleEn, description; buyer; amount (value, currency, valueUsd); status, procedureType; publishedDate, closingDate; awardees. Input: countries, sectors or keywords, status; optional publishedWithinDays, minAmountUsd, buyers, tenderIds. Try the Lite version first (no per-result charge, up to 25 results per run): https://apify.com/cleanyield/latam-public-tenders-lite · Price today: USD 8 per 1,000 tenders (USD 0.008 per tender) on the Apify Free plan; Apify subscribers pay less (Gold: USD 6.20 per 1,000).

## Use-case pages

- [Company enrichment API](https://cleanyield-data.github.io/company-enrichment-api/): Company enrichment API by domain: send company websites, get emails, phones and address when published, LinkedIn, socials, tech stack and hiring signals.
- [Find company emails from a website](https://cleanyield-data.github.io/find-company-emails-from-website/): Find company emails from any website: paste domains, get generic and role emails with the page they came from, phones when published and social profiles.
- [Greenhouse jobs API](https://cleanyield-data.github.io/greenhouse-jobs-api/): Greenhouse jobs API: type a company name or board URL and get its live open jobs with location, remote type, salary when posted and apply link, in JSON or CSV.
- [Workday jobs scraper](https://cleanyield-data.github.io/workday-jobs-scraper/): Workday jobs scraper: paste any myworkdayjobs.com careers site and get its live job postings with location, remote type, date, apply URL and salary when posted.
- [Job postings data API](https://cleanyield-data.github.io/job-postings-data-api/): Job postings data API: live jobs from careers pages on Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, iCIMS and 15 more ATS, by keyword, location or remote; salary if posted.
- [FMCSA carrier lookup API](https://cleanyield-data.github.io/fmcsa-carrier-lookup-api/): FMCSA carrier lookup API: search by USDOT or MC number, state or ZIP and get authority status, insurance on file, safety, fleet size, phone and a lead score.
- [App Store reviews API](https://cleanyield-data.github.io/app-store-reviews-api/): App Store reviews API: paste an iPhone app link and get its reviews with rating, title, text, date and app version, for any country, filtered by stars or date.
- [Google Play reviews scraper](https://cleanyield-data.github.io/google-play-reviews-scraper/): Google Play reviews scraper: paste an Android app link and get its reviews with rating, text, date, app version and developer reply, by language, JSON or CSV.
- [API de licitaciones públicas](https://cleanyield-data.github.io/licitaciones-publicas-api/): API de licitaciones públicas de Colombia (SECOP), Chile (Mercado Público), Brasil (PNCP) y Paraguay: monto en USD, comprador, fecha de cierre, título en inglés.
- [Enrich Google Maps leads with emails and phones](https://cleanyield-data.github.io/google-maps-leads-enrichment/): Enrich a Google Maps export with emails, phones and social profiles from each business website. Paste the rows as they are. It does not scrape Google Maps.

## Direct answers

- [How to get job postings from the Greenhouse API](https://cleanyield-data.github.io/greenhouse-job-board-api/): Greenhouse publishes every company’s open jobs in a free Job Board API that needs no key: GET https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/{board_token}/jobs?content=true. For one company that is enough; for many companies, salaries as a yearly range and the same format as Lever, Workday and 16 other hiring systems, use Clean Yield’s ATS Jobs Scraper.
- [How to get job postings from Workday](https://cleanyield-data.github.io/workday-jobs-api/): Workday has no documented public jobs API, but every myworkdayjobs.com careers site loads its list from a public JSON endpoint: POST https://{tenant}.wdN.myworkdayjobs.com/wday/cxs/{tenant}/{site}/jobs, 20 jobs per page. To skip the paging, the relative dates and one extra request per job, paste the careers site URL into Clean Yield’s ATS Jobs Scraper and get clean rows with exact posting dates.
- [How to get job postings from the Lever API](https://cleanyield-data.github.io/lever-postings-api/): Lever’s public Postings API returns a company’s published jobs with no key: GET https://api.lever.co/v0/postings/{company}?mode=json (EU-hosted boards use api.eu.lever.co). Clean Yield’s ATS Jobs Scraper reads the same feed for many companies at once, at the 1 request per second Lever asks for, and returns the salary when stated in the same format as Greenhouse and Workday.
- [How to look up an FMCSA carrier by MC number](https://cleanyield-data.github.io/fmcsa-mc-number-lookup-api/): For one carrier, search the MC number in FMCSA’s SAFER Company Snapshot (search by MC/MX number). For a list, or from code, Clean Yield’s FMCSA Carrier Lookup takes MC numbers and returns the USDOT number, legal name, authority status per docket, insurance on file and fleet size from FMCSA’s official data, re-checking statuses live on SAFER when the open data may be out of date.
- [How to get public tenders from Colombia and Chile by API](https://cleanyield-data.github.io/colombia-chile-public-tenders-api/): Colombia publishes its tenders as open data on datos.gov.co (SECOP II) and Chile through Mercado Público’s open OCDS API; both are free, but fields, currencies and status names differ. Clean Yield’s Latin America Public Tenders returns both, plus Brazil, Paraguay and Uruguay (beta), in one format with the bid deadline, the amount in USD when the tender states one and a link to the official notice.
- [¿Cómo obtener por API las licitaciones abiertas de Colombia (SECOP II)?](https://cleanyield-data.github.io/licitaciones-colombia-secop-api/): SECOP II publica sus procesos como datos abiertos en datos.gov.co (dataset p6dx-8zbt, API Socrata), gratis y sin registro. Si quieres solo las abiertas de verdad, con fecha de cierre, monto en pesos y en dólares y el link al aviso, en un formato listo para usar, la Licitaciones Públicas de Latinoamérica de Clean Yield lo hace en una corrida de segundos.
- [¿Cómo obtener las licitaciones de Mercado Público (Chile) por API sin ticket?](https://cleanyield-data.github.io/licitaciones-chile-mercado-publico-api/): La API clásica de Mercado Público pide un ticket, pero ChileCompra también publica las licitaciones en su API OCDS abierta (apis.mercadopublico.cl/OCDS), sin registro. La Licitaciones Públicas de Latinoamérica de Clean Yield la lee por ti y devuelve cada licitación con comprador y RUT, región, fecha de cierre y monto en pesos y en dólares cuando se informa.
